 "new_content": "import express from 'express';\nimport dotenv from 'dotenv';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'url';\nimport { GoogleGenAI } from '@google/genai';\n\ndotenv.config();\n\nconst __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nconst app = express();\nconst PORT = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000;\n\napp.use(express.json({ limit: '15mb' }));\n\n// Initialize GoogleGenAI\nconst apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;\nconst ai = apiKey\n  ? new GoogleGenAI({\n      apiKey,\n      httpOptions: {\n        headers: {\n          'User-Agent': 'aistudio-build',\n        },\n      },\n    })\n  : null;\n\n// Quota & Rate Limit Protection (Circuit breaker for 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED)\nlet globalQuotaCooldownUntil = 0;\n\nfunction isQuotaExhaustedError(err: any): boolean {\n  if (!err) return false;\n  const status = err.status || err.code;\n  const msg = String(err.message || err).toLowerCase();\n  return (\n    status === 429 ||\n    msg.includes('429') ||\n    msg.includes('resource_exhausted') ||\n    msg.includes('quota') ||\n    msg.includes('rate limit')\n  );\n}\n\nfunction handleAiError(scope: string, err: any) {\n  if (isQuotaExhaustedError(err)) {\n    // 10-minute cooldown where no external calls are made; graceful fallbacks are served\n    globalQuotaCooldownUntil = Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000;\n  } else {\n    console.warn(`[${scope}] handled gracefully:`, err?.message || err);\n  }\n}\n\n// Health check endpoint\napp.get('/api/health', (_req, res) => {\n  res.json({\n    status: 'ok',\n    hasApiKey: Boolean(apiKey),\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n  });\n});\n\n// Chat API endpoint for Companion\napp.post('/api/chat', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    const { messages = [], studentName = 'طالب', grade = 'Grade 5', language = 'ar', schoolBrainContext = null } = req.body;\n\n    const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n    const lastUserMsg = (messages[messages.length - 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n      tokensIn: params.tokensIn,\n      tokensOut: params.tokensOut,\n      costUsd,\n      latencyMs: Math.round(params.latencyMs),\n      status: params.status || 'success',\n      studentId: params.studentId || '',\n    };\n\n    this.logs.push(metric);\n    this.saveLogs();\n\n    // Check operator degradation alert (silent to student)\n    const todaySummary = this.getSummaryForDate(today);\n    if (todaySummary.exceededCostBudget) {\n      console.warn(\n        `[TELEMETRY OPERATOR ALERT] Daily cost limit exceeded for student: $${todaySummary.totalCostUsd.toFixed(\n          4\n        )} / $${TELEMETRY_TARGETS.DAILY_COST_LIMIT_USD}. Engaging graceful degradation.`\n      );\n    }\n\n    return metric;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Aggregate metrics for a specific date\n   */\n  public getSummaryForDate(dateStr: string): DayMetricSummary {\n    const daysLogs = this.logs.filter((l) => l.date === dateStr);\n    const callCount = daysLogs.length;\n\n    let totalTokensIn = 0;\n    let totalTokensOut = 0;\n    let totalCostUsd = 0;\n    const latencies: number[] = [];\n    const endpointBreakdown: Record<string, { calls: number; costUsd: number; avgLatencyMs: number }> = {};\n\n    for (const log of daysLogs) {\n      totalTokensIn += log.tokensIn;\n      totalTokensOut += log.tokensOut;\n      totalCostUsd += log.costUsd;\n      latencies.push(log.latencyMs);\n\n      if (!endpointBreakdown[log.endpoint]) {\n        endpointBreakdown[log.endpoint] = { calls: 0, costUsd: 0, avgLatencyMs: 0 };\n      }\n      endpointBreakdown[log.endpoint].calls += 1;\n      endpointBreakdown[log.endpoint].costUsd += log.costUsd;\n      endpointBreakdown[log.endpoint].avgLatencyMs += log.latencyMs;\n    }\n\n    // Compute averages\n    for (const ep in endpointBreakdown) {\n      if (endpointBreakdown[ep].calls > 0) {\n        endpointBreakdown[ep].avgLatencyMs = Math.round(\n          endpointBreakdown[ep].avgLatencyMs / endpointBreakdown[ep].calls\n        );\n      }\n    }\n\n    latencies.sort((a, b) => a - b);\n    const avgLatencyMs = latencies.length > 0 ? Math.round(latencies.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / latencies.length) : 0;\n    const p95Idx = Math.floor(latencies.length * 0.95);\n    const p95LatencyMs = latencies.length > 0 ? latencies[p95Idx] || latencies[latencies.length - 1] : 0;\n\n    return {\n      date: dateStr,\n      callCount,\n      totalTokensIn,\n      totalTokensOut,\n      totalCostUsd,\n      avgLatencyMs,\n      p95LatencyMs,\n      exceededCostBudget: totalCostUsd > TELEMETRY_TARGETS.DAILY_COST_LIMIT_USD,\n      endpointBreakdown,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get 7-day history aggregates\n   */\n  public getLast7DaysSummaries(): DayMetricSummary[] {\n    const days: DayMetricSummary[] = [];\n    const now = new Date();\n\n    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_HISTORY_DAYS; i++) {\n      const d = new Date(now.getTime() - i * 24 * 3600 * 1000);\n      const dateStr = localDateStr(d);\n      days.push(this.getSummaryForDate(dateStr));\n    }\n\n    return days;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Check if graceful degradation should be engaged\n   */\n  public getDegradationStatus(): DegradationModeStatus {\n    const today = localDateStr();\n    const todaySummary = this.getSummaryForDate(today);\n\n    // If today's cost is >= 80% of limit or recent calls are timing out\n    const isCostNearLimit = todaySummary.totalCostUsd >= TELEMETRY_TARGETS.DAILY_COST_LIMIT_USD * 0.8;\n    const recentLogs = this.logs.slice(-5);\n    const highLatencyDetected = recentLogs.length >= 3 && recentLogs.every((l) => l.latencyMs > 3500);\n\n    const isActive = isCostNearLimit || highLatencyDetected;\n    const reason = isCostNearLimit\n      ? `Daily spend threshold reached ($${todaySummary.totalCostUsd.toFixed(3)} / $0.50)`\n      : highLatencyDetected\n      ? 'Elevated latency detected on consecutive AI calls'\n      : undefined;\n\n    return {\n      isActive,\n      reason,\n      reuseCachedExplanations: isActive,\n      shorterVoiceResponses: isActive,\n      preferLocalEvaluators: isActive,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Fetch with 15s timeout wrapper and automatic latency/token telemetry recording\n   */\n  public async instrumentedFetch<T = any>(\n    endpoint: string,\n    payload: any,\n    options: {\n      studentId?: string;\n      language?: 'ar' | 'en';\n      model?: string;\n      timeoutMs?: number;\n    } = {}\n  ): Promise<{ data: T; metric: ApiCallMetric }> {\n    const t0 = performance.now();\n    const timeout = options.timeoutMs || TELEMETRY_TARGETS.MAX_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS;\n    const controller = new AbortController();\n    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeout);\n\n    const lang = options.language || 'ar';\n    const payloadStr = JSON.stringify(payload);\n    const tokensIn = this.estimateTokens(payloadStr, lang);\n\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(endpoint, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: payloadStr,\n        signal: controller.signal,\n      });\n\n      clearTimeout(timer);\n      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);\n      const ct = res.headers.get('content-type') || '';\n      if (!ct.includes('application/json')) throw new Error('Non-JSON response');\n\n      const t1 = performance.now();\n      const latencyMs = Math.round(t1 - t0);\n\n      const data = await res.json();\n      const responseStr = JSON.stringify(data);\n      const tokensOut = this.estimateTokens(responseStr, lang);\n\n      const metric = this.recordCall({\n        endpoint,\n        model: options.model || data.model || 'gemini-3.8-flash',\n        tokensIn,\n        tokensOut,\n        latencyMs,\n        status: data.source === 'error_fallback' || data.degraded ? 'fallback' : 'success',\n        studentId: options.studentId,\n      });\n\n      return { data, metric };\n    } catch (err: any) {\n      clearTimeout(timer);\n      const t1 = performance.now();\n      const latencyMs = Math.round(t1 - t0);\n\n      const metric = this.recordCall({\n        endpoint,\n        model: options.model || 'local_fallback',\n        tokensIn,\n        tokensOut: 10,\n        latencyMs,\n        status: 'error',\n        studentId: options.studentId,\n      });\n\n      throw err;\n    }\n  }\n\n  public getRawLogs(): ApiCallMetric[] {\n    return [...this.logs];\n  }\n\n  public clearLogs() {\n    this.logs = [];\n    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {\n      localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY_LOGS);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const costLatencyService = new CostLatencyService();\n",

### MessageEvent — role: `assistant` — source: `agent` — id: `faadafed-91a4-4319-aea4-2515a393a366` — 2026-10-16T10:29:17.635379

```
All tasks are complete. Draft PR #4 is open and open-only (draft: true, base `main` ← head `fix/web-hosting-3`, 6 commits). `main` was never touched and nothing was deployed.

## What I did

| Task | Result | Commit |
|---|---|---|
| W0 | Preconditions passed; baseline lint 11 / 105 tests / build OK on `main` @ `1213c47` | — |
| W1 | Render installs devDeps (`--include=dev`), dead config dropped; smoke: `/api/health` 200 JSON, `/` 200 HTML | `60947b5` |
| W2 | **BLOCKED** — Docker build fails at line 21 (ERESOLVE); one-line fix tested but NOT committed (W2 is report-only) | none |
| W3 | SW v2: no 404 caching, subpath `/api/` fix, no API caching; verified in real Chromium via CDP | `8c397a5` |
| W4 | Pinch-zoom re-enabled | `ba29901` |
| W5 | Removed `open-app.html` (+ zero references); **fixed a real 404 infinite-redirect loop** | `03b2742` |
| W6 | Pages workflow confirmed `workflow_dispatch`-only; "manual only" comment added | `782374d` |
| W7 | Neutral fallback name, honest chat error, `clearTimeout` moved before `res.ok` | `a0bda5a` |

**Final verification:** lint 11 errors (unchanged from baseline), 105 tests pass (39 + 66), build exit 0, production smoke and browser checks both re-passed.

## Notable findings, reported in the PR

- **W5 found a real bug beyond the prompt:** `public/404.html` had an infinite redirect loop — CDP measured **423 navigations in 6 seconds**. I fixed the offending line plus a hardcoded meta-refresh that also looped on subpath hosts. After the fix all three cases settle in 2 navigations.
- **W7 deviation:** the prompt named "the one assertion" for the old fallback, but there were **two** (`integritySourceOfTruth.test.ts:44` and `adaptiveLoop.test.ts:321`). Updating only the first left the suite failing (38/39). I updated the second expected value too — same invariant, no assertion weakened — and flagged it.
- The `www.vestauth.com` string I hit in Docker output is just upstream `dotenv`'s own promotional log line — not an injection.

## Actions only you can do
1. **Merge** the draft PR (or tell me to commit the Dockerfile fix first).
2. **Unpublish the live Pages site** — Settings > Pages > Unpublish, or make the repo private. It's an old build, and a static host can't run the AI routes. I have no repo-settings access.
3. Apply/approve the one-line Dockerfile fix if you want it in.
4. Verify Render's current free-plan policy and set `GEMINI_API_KEY` / `GEMINI_MODEL` in the Render dashboard.

PR: https://github.com/madnessgate44-debug/Amina/pull/4
```

{
 "data": {
  "repo_name": "madnessgate44-debug/Amina",
  "source_branch": "fix/dockerfile-2",
  "target_branch": "main",
  "title": "fix(W2): install tsx with the legacy peer deps the Docker runtime needs",
  "body": "Draft. Not for merge. Human review required.\n\n## Why this PR exists\nPR #4 (`fix/web-hosting-3`, W1 + W3–W7) was **merged by the owner at 10:30:00Z**, before I pushed the W2 Dockerfile fix. So `main` (`c786245`) does not contain the Dockerfile fix. A merged PR's branch cannot receive a new PR, so this is a small follow-up on a fresh branch off the updated `main`.\n\nThis supersedes the earlier \"commit the Dockerfile fix\" request: the fix is now here instead of on PR #4.\n\n## Scope\nOne line, `Dockerfile` line 21 (W2):\n\n```diff\n-RUN npm install --no-save tsx@^4.21.0 && npm cache clean --force\n+RUN npm install --no-save --legacy-peer-deps --include=dev tsx@^4.21.0 && npm cache clean --force\n```\n\nWhy: the runtime stage sets `NODE_ENV=production`, so devDependencies are omitted and the install fails with `npm error ERESOLVE unable to resolve dependency tree`. `--include=dev` puts `tsx` (needed by `npm start`) back, and `--legacy-peer-deps` matches the rest of the file.\n\n## Evidence (on this exact branch = `main` + the one-line change)\n```\n$ docker build -t amina-test .\nDOCKER_BUILD=0\n$ docker run -d --name amina-test-run -p 3000:3000 amina-test\n$ curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" localhost:3000/api/health\n200\n$ curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code} %{content_type}\" localhost:3000/\n200 text/html; charset=UTF-8\n\nnpm run lint   → exit 1, 11 errors (unchanged from baseline)\nnpm test       → exit 0, 39 + 66 = 105 PASSED, 0 FAILED\nnpm run build  → exit 0\n```\n\n## What I could not verify\n- Docker on another CPU architecture or a remote registry.\n- Nothing else — this is a one-line change.\n\n## Owner actions required\n1. ```
"Can't find my repo" on Render is almost always one of these. Let me give you the fix for each, in order.

## Most likely: Render is a different GitHub account, or the app isn't installed yet

Check these in order:

### 1. Confirm Render is connected to GitHub at all
👉 **https://dashboard.render.com/select-repo**

Open that. If it shows a **Connect GitHub** / **Configure GitHub** button, click it. That single click is what installs the Render app and makes repos appear.

### 2. Confirm the Render GitHub App has access
👉 **https://github.com/settings/installations**

- Do you see **Render** in the list?
  - **No** → go here and install it: https://github.com/apps/render/installations/new (choose **All repositories**, which you said you're fine with).
  - **Yes** → click **Configure** → make sure repo access includes your account/the Amina repo → **Save**.

### 3. Confirm Render uses the *same* GitHub account
This is the #1 cause. On the Render dashboard:
👉 **https://dashboard.render.com/account**

- Check the GitHub username shown there.
- It must be the account that **owns** `madnessgate44-debug/Amina`.
- If it's a different GitHub account, log out of Render and sign in again with GitHub — pick the `madnessgate44-debug` account.

### 4. Confirm you're looking at the right org in Render
If `madnessgate44-debug` is an **organization** (not your personal account) and Render is connected only to your personal account, the org's repos won't show. Fix:
- 👉 https://github.com/settings/installations → **Render** → **Configure**
- If it asks which account, make sure it's granted for the `madnessgate44-debug` account.
- Or connect GitHub once more from the Render side: https://dashboard.render.com/select-repo

## Fastest path: skip the picker with a Direct URL

Instead of browsing for the repo, paste the repo URL straight in:

👉 **https://dashboard.render.com/blueprints/new**

Or use the standard "New +" flow:
1. 👉 https://dashboard.render.com/select-repo?type=blueprint
2. Click **Connect GitHub** if shown.
3. Type **`Amina`** in the search box — if it's truly connected it will filter down.

## If it still doesn't appear

Two possibilities:
- **Repo is private and the app wasn't granted it** → recheck step 2 above (grant access explicitly).
- **Name mismatch** → the repo is `madnessgate44-debug/Amina`. Confirm at https://github.com/madnessgate44-debug/Amina while signed in — if that 404s for you too, you may be signed into a different GitHub account than the one that owns it.

## Tell me which one it is

Reply with one of these and I'll give the exact next click:
1. Does **https://dashboard.render.com/account** show the same GitHub username that owns the repo?
2. Does **https://github.com/settings/installations** list **Render**?
3. Can you open https://github.com/madnessgate44-debug/Amina while logged in?

Those three answers pinpoint it exactly. I can't see your Render account, so I can't check them for you — but with those answers the fix is one step away.
```

### MessageEvent — role: `assistant` — source: `agent` — id: `54612e1c-1432-4c9c-9ef9-5aed6e60ea12` — 2026-10-16T11:07:47.577923

```
Posted. Here's the phone-only way — you can do every step on your phone.

## Open the app on your phone

**Tap this link on your phone:**
👉 **https://codespaces.new/madnessgate44-debug/Amina**

Then:

1. **Sign in** to GitHub if asked (the `madnessgate44-debug` account).
2. Pick **2-core** if it asks.
3. Tap **Create codespace**. Wait ~1–2 minutes — a code editor opens in your phone browser.

**Now run two commands.** At the bottom, tap **≡ menu → Terminal → New Terminal**. Type this and hit Enter:
```
npm install --legacy-peer-deps
```
Wait 1–3 min. Then:
```
npm run dev
```

**Your app opens.** A popup says *"running on port 3000 is available"* → tap **Open in Browser**. If you miss it: tap the **Ports** tab → find port **3000** → tap the **globe icon**.

**When done, stop it** (saves your free hours): **≡ → Codespaces → Stop Current Codespace**, or go to https://github.com/codespaces and tap **Stop**.

## A few things to know

- The link looks like `https://xxxx-3000.app.github.dev`. It works **only while the codespace runs and you're signed into GitHub** in that phone browser. It's not a public website — so nothing is exposed, and nobody else can visit it.
- **First time only**, GitHub may ask you to enable Codespaces and accept free usage. The free tier is 120 core-hours/month (a 2-core machine ≈ 60 hours of use). Stop it when you're done.
- **No key needed.** The app runs without Gemini; AI replies just say honestly that they can't reach the assistant. If you want real AI replies later, run `GEMINI_API_KEY=paste-key npm run dev` instead.

## If it breaks

Reply with what you see and I'll fix it:
- Red errors during `npm install` → paste the last few lines.
- No popup and no Ports tab → reopen **≡ → Terminal → New Terminal** and re-run `npm run dev`.

Permanent copy on the PR (open it on your phone): **https://github.com/madnessgate44-debug/Amina/pull/5#issuecomment-6214166595**
```
